definition: m13_net_revenue: NET revenue (product only; shipping/tax excluded via i.itemtype IS NOT NULL and tl.taxline='F'; CustCred/CustRfnd deducted; SUM(-tl.foreignamount)) from subsidiary-2 transactions of Customers (stage LIKE 'CUSTOMER%', firstorderdate NOT NULL, category NOT IN (2 Garage Experts, 14 Vendor)) created in this cohort month (TO_CHAR(datecreated,'YYYY-MM')), for transactions dated trandate >= TRUNC(datecreated) AND trandate < TRUNC(datecreated) + 90, i.e. the first 90 calendar days starting on the creation day. customers_m13: COUNT(DISTINCT customer) with a qualifying line in that window. m1_net_revenue_live: same join, TO_CHAR(trandate,'YYYY-MM') = TO_CHAR(datecreated,'YYYY-MM'), pulled live. *_v1_timestamp_basis: the same window written as trandate >= datecreated (timestamp, not day), which drops same-day orders placed after the record's creation time; carried only because v1's published matched-cohort totals were computed on that basis. Query: src/data/queries/cohorts_m13.sql.
